_comment: First-run configuration. Everything the extension ships with lives here so
it can be edited without touching code — change a value, reload the
extension, and hit 'Reset everything to defaults' in settings to adopt it
(existing saved settings are not overwritten by a reload).
path:   optional, scopes a rule to part of a site, e.g. '/shorts'
always: true gates around the clock; set false to use days/from/until
wait/unlock on a rule: null means 'use the level preset'
clipFiles: ships empty. Clips live in src/assets/clips/, which is
gitignored so no video is redistributed with the repo or the store
build. Drop your own .mp4 in there and add its path here to use it;
with none listed the gate shows a quote, which is the intended
clipSound: try to play clips with sound. Browsers may refuse; the gate
then falls back to muted and offers an unmute button.
presets[level].steps: optional — narrows the global step toggles for that
level only. Omit it and the level runs every step that is globally on.
